# Sooauth

> Open-source, developer-owned authentication designed for vibecoders, AI-assisted development, and modern indie stacks. Standard OIDC, passkeys, hosted auth pages, and an embedded admin panel.

Sooauth provides a zero-homework authentication layer. Unlike Clerk, there is no vendor lock-in or per-MAU scaling trap. Unlike Better Auth, there are no database migrations or schema adapters to maintain in your app. Unlike Keycloak, it runs as a lightweight single Go binary or lean Docker container (Postgres + Redis).

Use the hosted cloud at `https://auth.sooauth.com` or self-host anywhere via Docker.

## Quick Facts for AI Agents

- **Protocol:** Standard OpenID Connect (OIDC) with PKCE (RFC 7636).
- **Discovery Endpoint:** `/.well-known/openid-configuration`
- **JWKS Endpoint:** `/.well-known/jwks.json`
- **Hosted Auth Pages:** `/auth/sign-in`, `/auth/sign-up`, `/auth/security`
- **Client SDK:** `@sooauth/sdk-js` (works with React, Next.js, Remix, Node.js, and any OIDC library like `next-auth`, `jose`, or `@auth/core`).
- **Backend Tech:** Go 1.23+, PostgreSQL, Redis.

## Core Endpoints

- **Issuer URL (Hosted):** `https://auth.sooauth.com`
- **Discovery:** `GET {ISSUER}/.well-known/openid-configuration`
- **Authorization:** `GET {ISSUER}/oauth/authorize?response_type=code&client_id={CLIENT_ID}&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}&scope=openid profile email&code_challenge={CHALLENGE}&code_challenge_method=S256`
- **Token Exchange:** `POST {ISSUER}/oauth/token` (form-urlencoded: `grant_type=authorization_code`, `code`, `redirect_uri`, `client_id`, `code_verifier`)
- **User Info:** `GET {ISSUER}/oauth/userinfo` (Bearer token)
- **Sign Out:** `POST {ISSUER}/auth/sign-out`

## Standard Environment Variables

In client applications (e.g. Next.js, Remix, Node, Python):

```env
SOOAUTH_ISSUER=https://auth.sooauth.com
SOOAUTH_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
SOOAUTH_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/sooauth
```

## Quick Integration (Next.js & JS SDK)

```bash
npm install @sooauth/sdk-js
```

```typescript
import { createSooauthClient } from "@sooauth/sdk-js";

export const auth = createSooauthClient({
  issuer: process.env.SOOAUTH_ISSUER || "https://auth.sooauth.com",
  clientId: process.env.SOOAUTH_CLIENT_ID!,
  redirectUri: process.env.SOOAUTH_REDIRECT_URI!,
});

// 1. Redirect to sign-in
await auth.signInWithRedirect();

// 2. Handle callback on redirect URI route
const session = await auth.handleCallback();
console.log("Logged in user:", session.user);
```
